title: Open WebUI tools API -- T1552 response-model field readmission leaks tool source + embedded credentials
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-70491 (GHSA-3r7g-q6cg-q2vx,
CVSS 6.5 MEDIUM), affecting Open WebUI 0.10.2 and earlier.

`GET /api/v1/tools/`, `GET /api/v1/tools/list`, and
`GET /api/v1/tools/id/{id}` (`backend/open_webui/routers/tools.py`)
returned full Python tool source to authenticated NON-ADMIN,
read-only users. The response model `ToolResponse` deliberately omits
`source` and `specs` fields -- but a sibling model, `ToolUserResponse`,
permits EXTRA fields, and the route handlers spread a full tool model
dump into the response, re-admitting the fields `ToolResponse` was
built to omit. A non-admin user with nothing more than a read grant on
a tool can therefore pull another user's server-side tool source code
-- which commonly embeds hard-coded API keys, credentials, and
internal service URLs directly in the Python source.

Detection logic flags a response from one of the three affected
endpoints whose body contains a `source` field with non-empty Python
content -- the exact field `ToolResponse` was designed to omit, whose
presence in the response IS the vulnerability manifesting, not merely
a precursor to it.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact router file, the two response models by
name, and the PR), fixed in 0.11.0.
